meta.name: Iyanu
meta.description:
Set in the magical kingdom of Yorubaland, follow teenage orphan girl, Iyanu, a heroine who must uncover the mystery behind her newfound powers to save her people from an ancient curse threatening to destroy humanity.

Rated TV-PG · Returning Series · First aired 5 Apr 2025 · South Africa, United Kingdom · Language: English
Studio: Lion Forge Animation, Forefront Media Group, Impact X Capital · Network: Cartoon Network

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/11 (missing E11) | S2 not on server

videos.title: The Chosen
videos.overview: Iyanu, aka The Chosen, triggers her Divine Powers, escapes Elu, and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind the evil lurking in Yorubaland.

videos.title: The Exiles
videos.overview: Fleeing evil Chancellor Nuro, Iyanu meets the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and Biyi. As she uncovers her powers, she explores hidden Wonders beyond Elu.

videos.title: The Eso of Eso
videos.overview: Kanfo, leader of the Eso Warriors, brings his son Toye to hunt Iyanu, while she meets Mama Sewa, a sage with secret knowledge of her past and powers.

videos.title: The Arrival
videos.overview: As Elu's political climate worsens, Iyanu intensifies her training with Sewa while two armies converge on the Riverlands Settlement to capture her.

videos.title: The People of the Deep
videos.overview: Iyanu, Biyi and Sewa battle the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and the People of the Deep, while Elu's Workers demand justice from the King and Nuro.

videos.title: The Walk of Death
videos.overview: Iyanu, Biyi, Toye and Ekun (aka TEAM CHOSEN) cross The Rinku Plains to find The Source, key to Iyanu's powers and lifting the Curse on Yorubaland.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: As Elu falls into civil war, Biyi and the Oba share stories of heartbreak. Team Chosen struggles to reach The Source while Olori searches for Iyanu.

videos.title: The Sacred
videos.overview: Team Chosen reaches The Sacred Settlement, where Iyanu must pass three Trials to prove she's The Chosen, while Nuro, now possessed, pursues them.

videos.title: The Source (1)
videos.overview: As Cursed animals besiege Elu, Iyanu searches for The Source. Meanwhile, Biyi, Toye, Olori and Kanfo battle Nuro's forces to buy time for Iyanu.

videos.title: The Source (2)
videos.overview: Iyanu reaches The Source and faces a devastating choice. As Elu nears destruction, her allies fight a final battle against Nuro and the Fallen One.
